costRevenueImpactInformation.costRevenueImpactShortDescription: Cost of DATSs (maintenance + annual fees)
Initial investment for the DATSs
Cost of fuel: Most of the fuel is used for soil preparation and sowing, but also for fertilization and other agronomic practices impacted by the DATSs
Cost of pesticides: The DSS, also thanks to the data from sensors, satellite and agrometeorological stations, enables a better management of phytosanitary treatments
Cost of fertilizers: An increase in fertilizer costs is observed, not due to an increase in the quantity distributed, but due to the different types and costs of the fertilizers used
Cost of labour for pesticides application: A decrease in the number of plant protection products and field interventions has reduced the work associated with this activity
Cost of labour for fertilization: A decrease in the number of fertilizations and fertilizers applied has reduced the work associated with this activity
Cost of labour for soil preparation and sowing: The DATS can help optimize field operations and, therefore, also save on energy inputs
Cost of labour for field visits: Thanks to the ability to monitor and manage the farm remotely, the DATS allows for more efficient field visits
